import fastifyStatic from "@fastify/static";
import Fastify, { type FastifyError, type FastifyInstance } from "fastify";
import type { AppConfig } from "./config.js";
import type { AppDatabase } from "./db/database.js";
import { registerHealthRoutes } from "./routes/health.js";

export interface AppDependencies {
  config: AppConfig;
  database: AppDatabase;
  now?: () => Date;
}

export async function buildApp(dependencies: AppDependencies): Promise<FastifyInstance> {
  const app = Fastify({
    logger: dependencies.config.nodeEnv !== "test",
    bodyLimit: 512 * 1024,
  });

  app.decorate("database", dependencies.database);
  app.decorate("now", dependencies.now ?? (() => new Date()));

  await app.register(helmet, {
    global: true,
    contentSecurityPolicy: {
      directives: {
        defaultSrc: ["'self'"],
        baseUri: ["'none'"],
        frameAncestors: ["'none'"],
        formAction: ["'self'"],
        imgSrc: ["'self'", "data:"],
        scriptSrc: ["'self'"],
        styleSrc: ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'"],
      },
    },
    crossOriginResourcePolicy: { policy: "same-origin" },
    referrerPolicy: { policy: "no-referrer" },
  });

  app.addHook("onRequest", async (request, reply) => {
    if (!["POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"].includes(request.method)) return;

    const contentType = request.headers["content-type"];
    if (request.method !== "DELETE" && !contentType?.toLowerCase().startsWith("application/json")) {
      await reply.code(415).send({
        code: "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE",
        message: "Mutation requests must use application/json.",
      });
      return;
    }

    const origin = request.headers.origin;
    if (origin) {
      const expected = `${request.protocol}://${request.headers.host}`;
      if (origin !== expected) {
        await reply.code(403).send({
          code: "ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED",
          message: "This request origin is not allowed.",
        });
      }
    }
  });

  app.setErrorHandler((error: FastifyError, _request, reply) => {
    const statusCode = error.statusCode && error.statusCode >= 400 ? error.statusCode : 500;
    const validation = "validation" in error && Array.isArray(error.validation);
    reply.code(statusCode).send({
      code: validation
        ? "VALIDATION_ERROR"
        : statusCode >= 500
          ? "INTERNAL_ERROR"
          : "REQUEST_ERROR",
      message:
        statusCode >= 500
          ? "The request could not be completed."
          : validation
            ? "One or more request fields are invalid."
            : error.message,
    });
  });

  await registerHealthRoutes(app);

  if (fs.existsSync(path.join(dependencies.config.clientDirectory, "index.html"))) {
    await app.register(fastifyStatic, {
      root: dependencies.config.clientDirectory,
      prefix: "/",
      wildcard: false,
    });

    app.setNotFoundHandler(async (request, reply) => {
      if (request.url.startsWith("/api/")) {
        return reply.code(404).send({ code: "NOT_FOUND", message: "Resource not found." });
      }
      return reply.type("text/html").sendFile("index.html");
    });
  } else {
    app.setNotFoundHandler(async (_request, reply) =>
      reply.code(404).send({ code: "NOT_FOUND", message: "Resource not found." }),
    );
  }

  return app;
}

## Modeling Rules

- Integer primary keys are internal identifiers; user-facing meaning lives in explicit fields.
- UTC timestamps use one consistent sortable representation and are generated by the server.
- Boolean values are stored as `0` or `1` with `CHECK` constraints.
- User-facing spelling is preserved separately from normalized uniqueness/search keys.
- All foreign-key child columns used by cascades are indexed.
- Bookmark, tag, FTS, saved-view, and selection changes that form one user action commit in one transaction.

## Bookmark

Represents one unique saved web destination.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | Primary key |
| `address` | text | Trimmed valid HTTP(S) destination retained for display/opening |
| `normalized_address` | text | Required, unique across active and archived bookmarks; derived by FR-005 rules |
| `address_revision` | integer | Starts at 1 and increments whenever the address changes; guards metadata races |
| `title` | text | Required display value; retrieved, user-authored, or address-derived fallback |
| `title_sort_key` | text | Required Unicode-normalized, case-folded title used for deterministic title ordering |
| `title_provenance` | enum | `fallback`, `retrieved`, or `user` |
| `retrieved_title_candidate` | nullable text | Latest retrieved alternative when a user title must not be overwritten |
| `description` | text | May be empty; retrieved or user-authored |
| `description_provenance` | enum | `fallback`, `retrieved`, or `user` |
| `retrieved_description_candidate` | nullable text | Latest retrieved alternative when a user description must not be overwritten |
| `icon_hash` | nullable text | Foreign key to a validated app-origin PNG; null uses the placeholder |
| `metadata_status` | enum | `pending`, `complete`, `partial`, `failed`, or `skipped_unsafe` |
| `metadata_error_code` | nullable enum | Friendly category such as timeout, denied destination, unsupported content, too large, or unavailable |
| `metadata_fetched_at` | nullable timestamp | Completion time of the last applicable attempt |
| `note_markdown` | text | Canonical user-authored note; empty by default |
| `note_plain` | text | Derived visible text used by search |
| `is_favorite` | boolean | Independent of reading/archive state; false by default |
| `is_unread` | boolean | True means Read Later; false by default |
| `archived_at` | nullable timestamp | Null means active; non-null means archived |
| `created_at` | timestamp | Immutable creation time |
| `updated_at` | timestamp | Refreshed by user-visible content/state changes and applied metadata |

### Bookmark Invariants

- `normalized_address` has a unique index. Application pre-checks improve UX; the constraint resolves races.
- A bookmark is in Read Later only when `is_unread = 1 AND archived_at IS NULL`.
- Archiving changes only `archived_at`; it never clears favorite or unread state.
- Restoring clears `archived_at`, so a retained unread bookmark reappears in Read Later.
- A metadata result may update a row only when its captured `address_revision` still equals the current value.
- A metadata result may update title or description only when that field's provenance is not `user`.
- Changing an address first checks uniqueness. On conflict, the edited bookmark remains unchanged.
- `note_plain` and the search index update in the same transaction as `note_markdown`.
- `title_sort_key` updates in the same transaction as `title` and title sorting uses `id` as the final tie-breaker.

### Bookmark State Transitions

```text
Reading:  read <──────────────> unread / Read Later
Archive:  active ─────────────> archived
          archived ───────────> active

Metadata: pending ────────────> complete
          pending ────────────> partial
          pending ────────────> failed
          pending ────────────> skipped_unsafe
          any non-pending ────> pending (address change or explicit refresh)

Deletion: active or archived ─> permanently removed
```

Reading and favorite transitions are independent from archive transitions.

## Bookmark Icon

Stores a safe, deduplicated site icon served only from the app origin.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `content_hash` | text | Primary key generated from re-encoded bytes |
| `png_bytes` | blob | Validated, bounded, re-encoded PNG only |
| `width` | integer | Positive and within the configured icon bound |
| `height` | integer | Positive and within the configured icon bound |
| `byte_length` | integer | Positive and within the configured transfer/storage bound |
| `created_at` | timestamp | Cache creation time |

An icon row may be referenced by many bookmarks. Unreferenced icons may be removed by maintenance; losing an icon never loses a bookmark and falls back to the placeholder.

## Tag

Represents a reusable flat label.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | Primary key |
| `display_name` | text | Trimmed user-facing spelling |
| `name_key` | text | Unicode-normalized, whitespace-normalized, case-folded unique key |
| `created_at` | timestamp | Creation time |

`name_key` is unique. A repeated spelling variant resolves to the existing tag.

## Bookmark Tag

Many-to-many relationship between bookmarks and tags.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `bookmark_id` | integer | Foreign key to Bookmark, cascade on delete |
| `tag_id` | integer | Foreign key to Tag, cascade on delete |

The composite `(bookmark_id, tag_id)` is the primary key. An index on `(tag_id, bookmark_id)` supports exact tag expressions, multi-tag filters, and bulk tag actions. Tags left with no bookmark may be garbage-collected, but saved views preserve their own tag keys.

## Saved View

Stores live search/filter criteria, never bookmark result identifiers.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | Primary key |
| `display_name` | text | Trimmed non-empty user-facing name |
| `name_key` | text | Unicode-normalized, case-folded unique key |
| `query_text` | text | Original validated search expression |
| `grammar_version` | integer | Starts at 1; migration point for future syntax changes |
| `scope` | enum | `active`, `read_later`, or `archived` |
| `favorite_filter` | nullable boolean | Null means any |
| `unread_filter` | nullable boolean | Null means any; scope rules still apply |
| `sort_order` | enum | `created_desc`, `created_asc`, `updated_desc`, or `title_asc` |
| `created_at` | timestamp | Creation time |
| `updated_at` | timestamp | Last rename or criteria update |

`name_key` is unique. The search expression must parse successfully before create/update. Opening a saved view reparses and evaluates current data.

## Saved View Tag

Stores one required tag filter for a saved view.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `saved_view_id` | integer | Foreign key to Saved View, cascade on delete |
| `tag_key` | text | Preserved normalized tag criterion |
| `display_name` | text | Last saved display label |

The composite `(saved_view_id, tag_key)` is the primary key. `tag_key` deliberately does not reference the live Tag table: deleting the last use of a tag leaves the saved criterion intact and produces the specified editable empty result.

## Selection Set

An expiring, non-user-content snapshot used for safe bulk actions.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | text | Opaque random token primary key |
| `criteria_hash` | text | Hash of the view state that produced the selection |
| `selected_count` | integer | Count shown for confirmation |
| `created_at` | timestamp | Snapshot time |
| `expires_at` | timestamp | Short expiry; abandoned sets are deleted on startup and periodically |

Selection sets are not restored as user state after expiration and do not appear in backups as meaningful content.

## Selection Item

Materializes selection membership.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `selection_id` | text | Foreign key to Selection Set, cascade on delete |
| `bookmark_id` | integer | Foreign key to Bookmark, cascade on delete |

The composite `(selection_id, bookmark_id)` is the primary key. An index on `bookmark_id` supports cascades. A view change deletes the current set; a bulk action consumes and deletes it in the same transaction.

## Bookmark Search Index

A contentful FTS5 virtual table whose `rowid` equals `bookmarks.id`.

| Column | Content |
|---|---|
| `title` | Search-normalized title |
| `address` | Search-normalized destination address |
| `description` | Search-normalized description |
| `note_plain` | Search-normalized visible note text |

The table uses the trigram tokenizer over already case-normalized text. Tags stay relational. Bookmark and FTS rows are inserted, updated, and deleted in one transaction, and integrity is checked in migration/maintenance tests.

## Schema Migration

Tracks ordered, immutable SQL migrations.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | integer | Primary key |
| `name` | text | Migration label |
| `applied_at` | timestamp | Successful application time |

Startup applies pending migrations transactionally before the server reports ready.

## Index Plan

- Unique: `bookmarks(normalized_address)`
- Listing: `(archived_at, created_at, id)`, `(archived_at, updated_at, id)`, `(archived_at, title_sort_key, id)`
- Status: `(archived_at, is_unread, created_at, id)`, `(archived_at, is_favorite, created_at, id)`
- Tags: unique `tags(name_key)`, `bookmark_tags(tag_id, bookmark_id)`, and its primary key
- Saved views: unique `saved_views(name_key)`, `saved_view_tags(tag_key, saved_view_id)`
- Selections: primary membership key and `selection_items(bookmark_id)`

The implementation must verify these with representative `EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN` output and the approved elapsed-time acceptance tests rather than relying on index presence alone.
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Personal Bookmark Manager API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Same-origin JSON contract for the approved single-user application.
  license:
    name: Proprietary
    identifier: LicenseRef-Proprietary
servers:
  - url: /api
security: []
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Check application readiness
      operationId: getHealth
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Server and migrated database are ready.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [status]
                properties:
                  status:
                    const: ready
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'

  /metadata/preview:
    post:
      summary: Preview metadata for an address
      operationId: previewMetadata
      description: Begins automatically after a valid address is entered. The client may save independently while this bounded request is pending.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [address]
              properties:
                address:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Retrieved metadata or a usable fallback result.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/MetadataPreview'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/DuplicateBookmark'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'

  /bookmarks:
    get:
      summary: List and search bookmarks
      operationId: listBookmarks
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Scope'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Query'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Tags'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Favorite'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Unread'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Sort'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Cursor'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Limit'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Current result page and total result count.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookmarkPage'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/SearchError'
    post:
      summary: Save a bookmark
      operationId: createBookmark
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookmarkCreate'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Bookmark saved; metadata may still be pending.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Bookmark'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/DuplicateBookmark'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'

  /bookmarks/{bookmarkId}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/BookmarkId'
    get:
      summary: Get a bookmark
      operationId: getBookmark
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Bookmark detail.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Bookmark'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
    patch:
      summary: Update a bookmark
      operationId: updateBookmark
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookmarkPatch'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated bookmark.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Bookmark'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/DuplicateBookmark'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'
    delete:
      summary: Permanently delete a bookmark
      operationId: deleteBookmark
      description: The client must obtain explicit user confirmation before sending this request.
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Permanently deleted.
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'

  /bookmarks/{bookmarkId}/metadata-refresh:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/BookmarkId'
    post:
      summary: Refresh bookmark metadata
      operationId: refreshBookmarkMetadata
      responses:
        '202':
          description: A revision-guarded metadata refresh was queued.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [bookmarkId, metadataStatus]
                properties:
                  bookmarkId:
                    type: integer
                  metadataStatus:
                    const: pending
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'

  /bookmarks/{bookmarkId}/icon:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/BookmarkId'
    get:
      summary: Get a safe bookmark icon
      operationId: getBookmarkIcon
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Validated app-origin PNG icon.
          headers:
            X-Content-Type-Options:
              schema:
                const: nosniff
          content:
            image/png:
              schema:
                type: string
                contentEncoding: binary
        '404':
          description: Use the client placeholder icon.

  /tags:
    get:
      summary: List tags
      operationId: listTags
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Existing tags and active bookmark counts.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/TagSummary'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'

  /selections:
    post:
      summary: Snapshot a bookmark selection
      operationId: createSelection
      description: Snapshots individual IDs or every bookmark matching the current criteria.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              oneOf:
                - type: object
                  additionalProperties: false
                  required: [mode, ids, criteriaHash]
                  properties:
                    mode:
                      const: ids
                    ids:
                      type: array
                      minItems: 1
                      uniqueItems: true
                      items:
                        type: integer
                    criteriaHash:
                      type: string
                - type: object
                  additionalProperties: false
                  required: [mode, criteria, criteriaHash]
                  properties:
                    mode:
                      const: all_results
                    criteria:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/SearchCriteria'
                    criteriaHash:
                      type: string
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Stable expiring selection snapshot.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Selection'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/SearchError'

  /selections/{selectionId}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/SelectionId'
    delete:
      summary: Clear a bookmark selection
      operationId: clearSelection
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Selection cleared or already absent.
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'

  /selections/{selectionId}/actions:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/SelectionId'
    post:
      summary: Apply a bulk action
      operationId: applyBulkAction
      description: Consumes the stable selection in one transaction. The client confirms permanent deletion before requesting it.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/BulkAction'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Selection consumed and action committed.
import { type Static, type TSchema, Type } from "typebox";

function inline<T extends TSchema>(schema: T): T {
  const copy = { ...schema } as T & { $id?: string };
  delete copy.$id;
  return copy;
}

/**
 * Shared JSON schemas for the successful request and response bodies in the
 * approved OpenAPI contract. These values are suitable for Fastify runtime
 * validation and their corresponding types are shared with the client.
 */

export const ScopeSchema = Type.Union(
  [Type.Literal("active"), Type.Literal("read_later"), Type.Literal("archived")],
  { $id: "Scope", default: "active" },
);
export type Scope = Static<typeof ScopeSchema>;

export const SortOrderSchema = Type.Union(
  [
    Type.Literal("created_desc"),
    Type.Literal("created_asc"),
    Type.Literal("updated_desc"),
    Type.Literal("title_asc"),
  ],
  { $id: "SortOrder", default: "created_desc" },
);
export type SortOrder = Static<typeof SortOrderSchema>;

export const MetadataStatusSchema = Type.Union(
  [
    Type.Literal("pending"),
    Type.Literal("complete"),
    Type.Literal("partial"),
    Type.Literal("failed"),
    Type.Literal("skipped_unsafe"),
  ],
  { $id: "MetadataStatus" },
);
export type MetadataStatus = Static<typeof MetadataStatusSchema>;

export const ProvenanceSchema = Type.Union(
  [Type.Literal("fallback"), Type.Literal("retrieved"), Type.Literal("user")],
  { $id: "Provenance" },
);
export type Provenance = Static<typeof ProvenanceSchema>;

export const BookmarkIdParamsSchema = Type.Object(
  { bookmarkId: Type.Integer() },
  { $id: "BookmarkIdParams", additionalProperties: false },
);
export type BookmarkIdParams = Static<typeof BookmarkIdParamsSchema>;

export const SavedViewIdParamsSchema = Type.Object(
  { savedViewId: Type.Integer() },
  { $id: "SavedViewIdParams", additionalProperties: false },
);
export type SavedViewIdParams = Static<typeof SavedViewIdParamsSchema>;

export const SelectionIdParamsSchema = Type.Object(
  { selectionId: Type.String() },
  { $id: "SelectionIdParams", additionalProperties: false },
);
export type SelectionIdParams = Static<typeof SelectionIdParamsSchema>;

export const HealthResponseSchema = Type.Object(
  { status: Type.Literal("ready") },
  { $id: "HealthResponse", additionalProperties: false },
);
export type HealthResponse = Static<typeof HealthResponseSchema>;

export const TagSchema = Type.Object(
  {
    id: Type.Integer(),
    name: Type.String(),
  },
  { $id: "Tag", additionalProperties: false },
);
export type Tag = Static<typeof TagSchema>;

export const TagSummarySchema = Type.Object(
  {
    id: Type.Integer(),
    name: Type.String(),
    activeBookmarkCount: Type.Integer({ minimum: 0 }),
  },
  { $id: "TagSummary", additionalProperties: false },
);
export type TagSummary = Static<typeof TagSummarySchema>;

export const TagSummaryListSchema = Type.Array(inline(TagSummarySchema), {
  $id: "TagSummaryList",
});
export type TagSummaryList = Static<typeof TagSummaryListSchema>;

export const BookmarkSchema = Type.Object(
  {
    id: Type.Integer(),
    address: Type.String({ format: "uri" }),
    title: Type.String(),
    titleProvenance: inline(ProvenanceSchema),
    retrievedTitleCandidate: Type.Optional(Type.Union([Type.String(), Type.Null()])),
    description: Type.String(),
    descriptionProvenance: inline(ProvenanceSchema),
    retrievedDescriptionCandidate: Type.Optional(Type.Union([Type.String(), Type.Null()])),
    iconUrl: Type.Union([Type.String(), Type.Null()]),
    metadataStatus: inline(MetadataStatusSchema),
    metadataErrorCode: Type.Optional(Type.Union([Type.String(), Type.Null()])),
    noteMarkdown: Type.String(),
    tags: Type.Array(inline(TagSchema)),
    favorite: Type.Boolean(),
    unread: Type.Boolean(),
    archived: Type.Boolean(),
    createdAt: Type.String({ format: "date-time" }),
    updatedAt: Type.String({ format: "date-time" }),
  },
  { $id: "Bookmark", additionalProperties: false },
);
export type Bookmark = Static<typeof BookmarkSchema>;

export const BookmarkCreateSchema = Type.Object(
  {
    address: Type.String(),
    title: Type.Optional(
      Type.String({
        description: "Omit unless the user manually overrides the automatic/fallback title.",
      }),
    ),
    description: Type.Optional(
      Type.String({
        description: "Omit unless the user manually overrides the automatic description.",
      }),
    ),
    noteMarkdown: Type.Optional(Type.String({ default: "" })),
    tags: Type.Optional(Type.Array(Type.String(), { uniqueItems: true })),
    favorite: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean({ default: false })),
    unread: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean({ default: false })),
  },
  { $id: "BookmarkCreate", additionalProperties: false },
);
export type BookmarkCreate = Static<typeof BookmarkCreateSchema>;

export const BookmarkPatchSchema = Type.Object(
  {
    address: Type.Optional(Type.String()),
    title: Type.Optional(Type.String()),
    description: Type.Optional(Type.String()),
    noteMarkdown: Type.Optional(Type.String()),
    tags: Type.Optional(Type.Array(Type.String(), { uniqueItems: true })),
    favorite: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),

export const MetadataPreviewRequestSchema = Type.Object(

export const MetadataPreviewSchema = Type.Object(
  {
    address: Type.String(),

    fallbackTitle: Type.String(),

    description: Type.String(),
    iconAvailable: Type.Boolean(),
    errorCode: Type.Optional(Type.Union([Type.String(), Type.Null()])),
  },
  { $id: "MetadataPreview", additionalProperties: false },
);
export type MetadataPreview = Static<typeof MetadataPreviewSchema>;

export const BookmarkPageSchema = Type.Object(
  {
    items: Type.Array(inline(BookmarkSchema)),

    nextCursor: Type.Union([Type.String(), Type.Null()]),
  },
  { $id: "BookmarkPage", additionalProperties: false },

export type BookmarkPage = Static<typeof BookmarkPageSchema>;

export const BookmarkListQuerySchema = Type.Object(
  {
    scope: Type.Optional(inline(ScopeSchema)),

  { $id: "BookmarkListQuery", additionalProperties: false },

export type BookmarkListQuery = Static<typeof BookmarkListQuerySchema>;

export const MetadataRefreshResponseSchema = Type.Object(
  {
    bookmarkId: Type.Integer(),
    metadataStatus: Type.Literal("pending"),
  },
  { $id: "MetadataRefreshResponse", additionalProperties: false },
);
export type MetadataRefreshResponse = Static<typeof MetadataRefreshResponseSchema>;

export const BookmarkIconResponseSchema = Type.String({
  $id: "BookmarkIconResponse",
  contentEncoding: "binary",
});
export type BookmarkIconResponse = Static<typeof BookmarkIconResponseSchema>;

import { DEFAULT_TEST_TIME } from "./clock.js";

export type MetadataStatus = "pending" | "complete" | "partial" | "failed" | "skipped_unsafe";
export type Provenance = "fallback" | "retrieved" | "user";
export type Scope = "active" | "read_later" | "archived";
export type SortOrder = "created_desc" | "created_asc" | "updated_desc" | "title_asc";

export interface TagFixture {
  id: number;
  name: string;
}

export interface BookmarkFixture {
  id: number;
  address: string;
  title: string;
  titleProvenance: Provenance;
  retrievedTitleCandidate: string | null;
  description: string;
  descriptionProvenance: Provenance;
  retrievedDescriptionCandidate: string | null;
  iconUrl: string | null;
  metadataStatus: MetadataStatus;
  metadataErrorCode: string | null;
  noteMarkdown: string;
  tags: TagFixture[];
  favorite: boolean;
  unread: boolean;
  archived: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface BookmarkRowFixture {
  id: number;

export function makeSearchCriteria(

export function makeSavedView(overrides: Partial<SavedViewFixture> = {}): SavedViewFixture {

export function makeSelection(overrides: Partial<SelectionFixture> = {}): SelectionFixture {

    criteriaHash: "sha256:deterministic-criteria-hash",
    expiresAt: "2026-01-02T03:19:05.000Z",
    ...overrides,
  };
}

export interface EntityFactories {
  bookmark: (overrides?: Partial<BookmarkFixture>) => BookmarkFixture;
  bookmarkRow: (overrides?: Partial<BookmarkRowFixture>) => BookmarkRowFixture;
  tag: (overrides?: Partial<TagFixture>) => TagFixture;
  savedView: (overrides?: Partial<SavedViewFixture>) => SavedViewFixture;
  selection: (overrides?: Partial<SelectionFixture>) => SelectionFixture;
  reset: () => void;
}

/** Returns sequence-backed factories for tests that need many distinct entities. */
export function createEntityFactories(): EntityFactories {
  let bookmarkId = 0;
  let tagId = 0;
  let savedViewId = 0;
  let selectionId = 0;

  return {
    bookmark: (overrides = {}) => makeBookmark({ id: ++bookmarkId, ...overrides }),
    bookmarkRow: (overrides = {}) => makeBookmarkRow({ id: ++bookmarkId, ...overrides }),
    tag: (overrides = {}) => makeTag({ id: ++tagId, ...overrides }),
    savedView: (overrides = {}) => makeSavedView({ id: ++savedViewId, ...overrides }),
    selection: (overrides = {}) =>
      makeSelection({ id: `selection-${String(++selectionId).padStart(8, "0")}`, ...overrides }),
    reset: () => {
      bookmarkId = 0;
      tagId = 0;
      savedViewId = 0;
      selectionId = 0;
    },
  };
}
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { type AppDatabase, closeDatabase, openDatabase } from "../../src/server/db/database.js";
import { runMigrations } from "../../src/server/db/migrate.js";

const DEFAULT_MIGRATIONS_DIRECTORY = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../migrations/", import.meta.url));

export interface TestDatabaseOptions {
  migrate?: boolean;
  migrationsDirectory?: string;
  prefix?: string;
}

export interface TestDatabase {
  database: AppDatabase;
  databasePath: string;
  directory: string;
  appliedMigrations: readonly number[];
  cleanup: () => void;
}

/**
 * Creates a real, file-backed database so WAL, locking, and uniqueness behavior
 * match production. Every call owns a separate mkdtemp directory.
 */
export function createTestDatabase(options: TestDatabaseOptions = {}): TestDatabase {
  const directory = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), options.prefix ?? "bookmark-garden-test-"));
  const databasePath = path.join(directory, "bookmarks.sqlite");
  const database = openDatabase(databasePath);
  let cleaned = false;

  try {
    const appliedMigrations =
      options.migrate === false
        ? []
        : runMigrations(database, options.migrationsDirectory ?? DEFAULT_MIGRATIONS_DIRECTORY);

    return {
      database,
      databasePath,
      directory,
      appliedMigrations,
      cleanup: () => {
        if (cleaned) return;
        cleaned = true;
        closeDatabase(database);
        rmSync(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    closeDatabase(database);
    rmSync(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function withTestDatabase<T>(
  run: (fixture: TestDatabase) => T | Promise<T>,
  options: TestDatabaseOptions = {},
): Promise<T> {
  const fixture = createTestDatabase(options);
  try {
    return await run(fixture);
  } finally {
    fixture.cleanup();
  }
}
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import helmet from "@fastify/helmet";
import fastifyStatic from "@fastify/static";
import Fastify, { type FastifyError, type FastifyInstance } from "fastify";
import type { AppConfig } from "./config.js";
import type { AppDatabase } from "./db/database.js";
import { registerHealthRoutes } from "./routes/health.js";

export interface AppDependencies {
  config: AppConfig;
  database: AppDatabase;
  now?: () => Date;
}

export async function buildApp(dependencies: AppDependencies): Promise<FastifyInstance> {
  const app = Fastify({
    logger: dependencies.config.nodeEnv !== "test",
    bodyLimit: 512 * 1024,
  });

  app.decorate("database", dependencies.database);
  app.decorate("now", dependencies.now ?? (() => new Date()));

  await app.register(helmet, {
    global: true,
    contentSecurityPolicy: {
      directives: {
        defaultSrc: ["'self'"],
        baseUri: ["'none'"],
        frameAncestors: ["'none'"],
        formAction: ["'self'"],
        imgSrc: ["'self'", "data:"],
        scriptSrc: ["'self'"],
        styleSrc: ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'"],
      },
    },
    crossOriginResourcePolicy: { policy: "same-origin" },
    referrerPolicy: { policy: "no-referrer" },
  });

  app.addHook("onRequest", async (request, reply) => {
    if (!["POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"].includes(request.method)) return;

    const contentType = request.headers["content-type"];
    if (request.method !== "DELETE" && !contentType?.toLowerCase().startsWith("application/json")) {
      await reply.code(415).send({
        code: "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE",
        message: "Mutation requests must use application/json.",
      });
      return;
    }

    const origin = request.headers.origin;
    if (origin) {
      const expected = `${request.protocol}://${request.headers.host}`;
      if (origin !== expected) {
        await reply.code(403).send({
          code: "ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED",
          message: "This request origin is not allowed.",
        });
      }
    }
  });

  app.setErrorHandler((error: FastifyError, _request, reply) => {
    const statusCode = error.statusCode && error.statusCode >= 400 ? error.statusCode : 500;
    const validation = "validation" in error && Array.isArray(error.validation);
    reply.code(statusCode).send({
      code: validation
        ? "VALIDATION_ERROR"
        : statusCode >= 500
          ? "INTERNAL_ERROR"
          : "REQUEST_ERROR",
      message:
        statusCode >= 500
          ? "The request could not be completed."
          : validation
            ? "One or more request fields are invalid."
            : error.message,
    });
  });

  await registerHealthRoutes(app);

  if (fs.existsSync(path.join(dependencies.config.clientDirectory, "index.html"))) {
    await app.register(fastifyStatic, {
      root: dependencies.config.clientDirectory,
      prefix: "/",
      wildcard: false,
    });

    app.setNotFoundHandler(async (request, reply) => {
      if (request.url.startsWith("/api/")) {
        return reply.code(404).send({ code: "NOT_FOUND", message: "Resource not found." });
      }
      return reply.type("text/html").sendFile("index.html");
    });
  } else {
    app.setNotFoundHandler(async (_request, reply) =>
      reply.code(404).send({ code: "NOT_FOUND", message: "Resource not found." }),
    );
  }

  return app;
}

# Data Model: Personal Bookmark Manager

**Date**: 2026-09-17  
**Database**: SQLite with foreign keys, WAL, and ordered migrations

## Modeling Rules

- Integer primary keys are internal identifiers; user-facing meaning lives in explicit fields.
- UTC timestamps use one consistent sortable representation and are generated by the server.
- Boolean values are stored as `0` or `1` with `CHECK` constraints.
- User-facing spelling is preserved separately from normalized uniqueness/search keys.
- All foreign-key child columns used by cascades are indexed.
- Bookmark, tag, FTS, saved-view, and selection changes that form one user action commit in one transaction.

## Bookmark

Represents one unique saved web destination.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | Primary key |
| `address` | text | Trimmed valid HTTP(S) destination retained for display/opening |
| `normalized_address` | text | Required, unique across active and archived bookmarks; derived by FR-005 rules |
| `address_revision` | integer | Starts at 1 and increments whenever the address changes; guards metadata races |
| `title` | text | Required display value; retrieved, user-authored, or address-derived fallback |
| `title_sort_key` | text | Required Unicode-normalized, case-folded title used for deterministic title ordering |
| `title_provenance` | enum | `fallback`, `retrieved`, or `user` |
| `retrieved_title_candidate` | nullable text | Latest retrieved alternative when a user title must not be overwritten |
| `description` | text | May be empty; retrieved or user-authored |
| `description_provenance` | enum | `fallback`, `retrieved`, or `user` |
| `retrieved_description_candidate` | nullable text | Latest retrieved alternative when a user description must not be overwritten |
| `icon_hash` | nullable text | Foreign key to a validated app-origin PNG; null uses the placeholder |
| `metadata_status` | enum | `pending`, `complete`, `partial`, `failed`, or `skipped_unsafe` |
| `metadata_error_code` | nullable enum | Friendly category such as timeout, denied destination, unsupported content, too large, or unavailable |
| `metadata_fetched_at` | nullable timestamp | Completion time of the last applicable attempt |
| `note_markdown` | text | Canonical user-authored note; empty by default |
| `note_plain` | text | Derived visible text used by search |
| `is_favorite` | boolean | Independent of reading/archive state; false by default |
| `is_unread` | boolean | True means Read Later; false by default |
| `archived_at` | nullable timestamp | Null means active; non-null means archived |
| `created_at` | timestamp | Immutable creation time |
| `updated_at` | timestamp | Refreshed by user-visible content/state changes and applied metadata |

### Bookmark Invariants

- `normalized_address` has a unique index. Application pre-checks improve UX; the constraint resolves races.
- A bookmark is in Read Later only when `is_unread = 1 AND archived_at IS NULL`.
- Archiving changes only `archived_at`; it never clears favorite or unread state.
- Restoring clears `archived_at`, so a retained unread bookmark reappears in Read Later.
- A metadata result may update a row only when its captured `address_revision` still equals the current value.
- A metadata result may update title or description only when that field's provenance is not `user`.
- Changing an address first checks uniqueness. On conflict, the edited bookmark remains unchanged.
- `note_plain` and the search index update in the same transaction as `note_markdown`.
- `title_sort_key` updates in the same transaction as `title` and title sorting uses `id` as the final tie-breaker.

### Bookmark State Transitions

```text
Reading:  read <──────────────> unread / Read Later
Archive:  active ─────────────> archived
          archived ───────────> active

Metadata: pending ────────────> complete
          pending ────────────> partial
          pending ────────────> failed
          pending ────────────> skipped_unsafe
          any non-pending ────> pending (address change or explicit refresh)

Deletion: active or archived ─> permanently removed
```

Reading and favorite transitions are independent from archive transitions.

## Bookmark Icon

Stores a safe, deduplicated site icon served only from the app origin.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `content_hash` | text | Primary key generated from re-encoded bytes |
| `png_bytes` | blob | Validated, bounded, re-encoded PNG only |
| `width` | integer | Positive and within the configured icon bound |
| `height` | integer | Positive and within the configured icon bound |
| `byte_length` | integer | Positive and within the configured transfer/storage bound |
| `created_at` | timestamp | Cache creation time |

An icon row may be referenced by many bookmarks. Unreferenced icons may be removed by maintenance; losing an icon never loses a bookmark and falls back to the placeholder.

## Tag

Represents a reusable flat label.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | Primary key |
| `display_name` | text | Trimmed user-facing spelling |
| `name_key` | text | Unicode-normalized, whitespace-normalized, case-folded unique key |
| `created_at` | timestamp | Creation time |

`name_key` is unique. A repeated spelling variant resolves to the existing tag.

## Bookmark Tag

Many-to-many relationship between bookmarks and tags.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `bookmark_id` | integer | Foreign key to Bookmark, cascade on delete |
| `tag_id` | integer | Foreign key to Tag, cascade on delete |

The composite `(bookmark_id, tag_id)` is the primary key. An index on `(tag_id, bookmark_id)` supports exact tag expressions, multi-tag filters, and bulk tag actions. Tags left with no bookmark may be garbage-collected, but saved views preserve their own tag keys.

## Saved View

Stores live search/filter criteria, never bookmark result identifiers.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | Primary key |
| `display_name` | text | Trimmed non-empty user-facing name |
| `name_key` | text | Unicode-normalized, case-folded unique key |
| `query_text` | text | Original validated search expression |
| `grammar_version` | integer | Starts at 1; migration point for future syntax changes |
| `scope` | enum | `active`, `read_later`, or `archived` |
| `favorite_filter` | nullable boolean | Null means any |
| `unread_filter` | nullable boolean | Null means any; scope rules still apply |
| `sort_order` | enum | `created_desc`, `created_asc`, `updated_desc`, or `title_asc` |
| `created_at` | timestamp | Creation time |
| `updated_at` | timestamp | Last rename or criteria update |

`name_key` is unique. The search expression must parse successfully before create/update. Opening a saved view reparses and evaluates current data.

## Saved View Tag

Stores one required tag filter for a saved view.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `saved_view_id` | integer | Foreign key to Saved View, cascade on delete |
| `tag_key` | text | Preserved normalized tag criterion |
| `display_name` | text | Last saved display label |

The composite `(saved_view_id, tag_key)` is the primary key. `tag_key` deliberately does not reference the live Tag table: deleting the last use of a tag leaves the saved criterion intact and produces the specified editable empty result.

## Selection Set

An expiring, non-user-content snapshot used for safe bulk actions.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | text | Opaque random token primary key |
| `criteria_hash` | text | Hash of the view state that produced the selection |
| `selected_count` | integer | Count shown for confirmation |
| `created_at` | timestamp | Snapshot time |
| `expires_at` | timestamp | Short expiry; abandoned sets are deleted on startup and periodically |

Selection sets are not restored as user state after expiration and do not appear in backups as meaningful content.

## Selection Item

Materializes selection membership.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `selection_id` | text | Foreign key to Selection Set, cascade on delete |
| `bookmark_id` | integer | Foreign key to Bookmark, cascade on delete |

The composite `(selection_id, bookmark_id)` is the primary key. An index on `bookmark_id` supports cascades. A view change deletes the current set; a bulk action consumes and deletes it in the same transaction.

## Bookmark Search Index

A contentful FTS5 virtual table whose `rowid` equals `bookmarks.id`.

| Column | Content |
|---|---|
| `title` | Search-normalized title |
| `address` | Search-normalized destination address |
| `description` | Search-normalized description |
| `note_plain` | Search-normalized visible note text |

The table uses the trigram tokenizer over already case-normalized text. Tags stay relational. Bookmark and FTS rows are inserted, updated, and deleted in one transaction, and integrity is checked in migration/maintenance tests.

## Schema Migration

Tracks ordered, immutable SQL migrations.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | integer | Primary key |
| `name` | text | Migration label |
| `applied_at` | timestamp | Successful application time |

Startup applies pending migrations transactionally before the server reports ready.

## Index Plan

- Unique: `bookmarks(normalized_address)`
- Listing: `(archived_at, created_at, id)`, `(archived_at, updated_at, id)`, `(archived_at, title_sort_key, id)`
- Status: `(archived_at, is_unread, created_at, id)`, `(archived_at, is_favorite, created_at, id)`
- Tags: unique `tags(name_key)`, `bookmark_tags(tag_id, bookmark_id)`, and its primary key
- Saved views: unique `saved_views(name_key)`, `saved_view_tags(tag_key, saved_view_id)`
- Selections: primary membership key and `selection_items(bookmark_id)`

The implementation must verify these with representative `EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN` output and the approved elapsed-time acceptance tests rather than relying on index presence alone.

info:
  title: Personal Bookmark Manager API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Same-origin JSON contract for the approved single-user application.
  license:
    name: Proprietary
    identifier: LicenseRef-Proprietary
servers:
  - url: /api
security: []
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Check application readiness
      operationId: getHealth
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Server and migrated database are ready.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [status]
                properties:
                  status:
                    const: ready
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'

  /metadata/preview:
    post:
      summary: Preview metadata for an address
      operationId: previewMetadata
      description: Begins automatically after a valid address is entered. The client may save independently while this bounded request is pending.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [address]
              properties:
                address:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Retrieved metadata or a usable fallback result.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/MetadataPreview'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/DuplicateBookmark'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'

  /bookmarks:
    get:
      summary: List and search bookmarks
      operationId: listBookmarks
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Scope'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Query'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Tags'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Favorite'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Unread'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Sort'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Cursor'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Limit'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Current result page and total result count.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookmarkPage'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/SearchError'
    post:
      summary: Save a bookmark
      operationId: createBookmark
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookmarkCreate'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Bookmark saved; metadata may still be pending.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Bookmark'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/DuplicateBookmark'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'

  /bookmarks/{bookmarkId}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/BookmarkId'
    get:
      summary: Get a bookmark
      operationId: getBookmark
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Bookmark detail.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Bookmark'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
    patch:
      summary: Update a bookmark
      operationId: updateBookmark
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookmarkPatch'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated bookmark.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Bookmark'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/DuplicateBookmark'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'
    delete:
      summary: Permanently delete a bookmark
      operationId: deleteBookmark
      description: The client must obtain explicit user confirmation before sending this request.
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Permanently deleted.
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'

  /bookmarks/{bookmarkId}/metadata-refresh:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/BookmarkId'
    post:
      summary: Refresh bookmark metadata
      operationId: refreshBookmarkMetadata
      responses:
        '202':
          description: A revision-guarded metadata refresh was queued.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [bookmarkId, metadataStatus]
                properties:
                  bookmarkId:
                    type: integer
                  metadataStatus:
                    const: pending
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'

  /bookmarks/{bookmarkId}/icon:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/BookmarkId'
    get:
      summary: Get a safe bookmark icon
      operationId: getBookmarkIcon
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Validated app-origin PNG icon.
          headers:
            X-Content-Type-Options:
              schema:
                const: nosniff
          content:
            image/png:
              schema:
                type: string
                contentEncoding: binary
        '404':
          description: Use the client placeholder icon.

  /tags:
    get:
      summary: List tags
      operationId: listTags
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Existing tags and active bookmark counts.
          content:

import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { type AppDatabase, closeDatabase, openDatabase } from "../../src/server/db/database.js";
import { runMigrations } from "../../src/server/db/migrate.js";

const DEFAULT_MIGRATIONS_DIRECTORY = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../migrations/", import.meta.url));

export interface TestDatabaseOptions {
  migrate?: boolean;
  migrationsDirectory?: string;
  prefix?: string;
}

export interface TestDatabase {
  database: AppDatabase;
  databasePath: string;
  directory: string;
  appliedMigrations: readonly number[];
  cleanup: () => void;
}

/**
 * Creates a real, file-backed database so WAL, locking, and uniqueness behavior
 * match production. Every call owns a separate mkdtemp directory.
 */
export function createTestDatabase(options: TestDatabaseOptions = {}): TestDatabase {
  const directory = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), options.prefix ?? "bookmark-garden-test-"));
  const databasePath = path.join(directory, "bookmarks.sqlite");
  const database = openDatabase(databasePath);
  let cleaned = false;

  try {
    const appliedMigrations =
      options.migrate === false
        ? []
        : runMigrations(database, options.migrationsDirectory ?? DEFAULT_MIGRATIONS_DIRECTORY);

    return {
      database,
      databasePath,
      directory,
      appliedMigrations,
      cleanup: () => {
        if (cleaned) return;
        cleaned = true;
        closeDatabase(database);
        rmSync(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    closeDatabase(database);
    rmSync(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function withTestDatabase<T>(
  run: (fixture: TestDatabase) => T | Promise<T>,
  options: TestDatabaseOptions = {},
): Promise<T> {
  const fixture = createTestDatabase(options);
  try {
    return await run(fixture);
  } finally {
    fixture.cleanup();
  }
}

import helmet from "@fastify/helmet";
import fastifyStatic from "@fastify/static";
import Fastify, { type FastifyError, type FastifyInstance } from "fastify";
import type { AppConfig } from "./config.js";
import type { AppDatabase } from "./db/database.js";
import { registerHealthRoutes } from "./routes/health.js";

export interface AppDependencies {
  config: AppConfig;
  database: AppDatabase;
  now?: () => Date;
}

export async function buildApp(dependencies: AppDependencies): Promise<FastifyInstance> {
  const app = Fastify({
    logger: dependencies.config.nodeEnv !== "test",
    bodyLimit: 512 * 1024,
  });

  app.decorate("database", dependencies.database);
  app.decorate("now", dependencies.now ?? (() => new Date()));

  await app.register(helmet, {
    global: true,
    contentSecurityPolicy: {
      directives: {
        defaultSrc: ["'self'"],
        baseUri: ["'none'"],
        frameAncestors: ["'none'"],
        formAction: ["'self'"],
        imgSrc: ["'self'", "data:"],
        scriptSrc: ["'self'"],
        styleSrc: ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'"],
      },
    },
    crossOriginResourcePolicy: { policy: "same-origin" },
    referrerPolicy: { policy: "no-referrer" },
  });

  app.addHook("onRequest", async (request, reply) => {
    if (!["POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"].includes(request.method)) return;

    const contentType = request.headers["content-type"];
    if (request.method !== "DELETE" && !contentType?.toLowerCase().startsWith("application/json")) {
      await reply.code(415).send({
        code: "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE",
        message: "Mutation requests must use application/json.",
      });
      return;
    }

    const origin = request.headers.origin;
    if (origin) {
      const expected = `${request.protocol}://${request.headers.host}`;
      if (origin !== expected) {
        await reply.code(403).send({
          code: "ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED",
          message: "This request origin is not allowed.",
        });
      }
    }
  });

  app.setErrorHandler((error: FastifyError, _request, reply) => {
    const statusCode = error.statusCode && error.statusCode >= 400 ? error.statusCode : 500;
    const validation = "validation" in error && Array.isArray(error.validation);
    reply.code(statusCode).send({
      code: validation
        ? "VALIDATION_ERROR"
        : statusCode >= 500
          ? "INTERNAL_ERROR"
          : "REQUEST_ERROR",
      message:
        statusCode >= 500
          ? "The request could not be completed."
          : validation
            ? "One or more request fields are invalid."
            : error.message,
    });
  });

  await registerHealthRoutes(app);

  if (fs.existsSync(path.join(dependencies.config.clientDirectory, "index.html"))) {
    await app.register(fastifyStatic, {
      root: dependencies.config.clientDirectory,
      prefix: "/",
      wildcard: false,
    });

    app.setNotFoundHandler(async (request, reply) => {
      if (request.url.startsWith("/api/")) {
        return reply.code(404).send({ code: "NOT_FOUND", message: "Resource not found." });
      }
      return reply.type("text/html").sendFile("index.html");
    });
  } else {
    app.setNotFoundHandler(async (_request, reply) =>
      reply.code(404).send({ code: "NOT_FOUND", message: "Resource not found." }),
    );
  }

  return app;
}

# Data Model: Personal Bookmark Manager

**Date**: 2026-09-17  
**Database**: SQLite with foreign keys, WAL, and ordered migrations

## Modeling Rules

- Integer primary keys are internal identifiers; user-facing meaning lives in explicit fields.
- UTC timestamps use one consistent sortable representation and are generated by the server.
- Boolean values are stored as `0` or `1` with `CHECK` constraints.
- User-facing spelling is preserved separately from normalized uniqueness/search keys.
- All foreign-key child columns used by cascades are indexed.
- Bookmark, tag, FTS, saved-view, and selection changes that form one user action commit in one transaction.

## Bookmark

Represents one unique saved web destination.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | Primary key |
| `address` | text | Trimmed valid HTTP(S) destination retained for display/opening |
| `normalized_address` | text | Required, unique across active and archived bookmarks; derived by FR-005 rules |
| `address_revision` | integer | Starts at 1 and increments whenever the address changes; guards metadata races |
| `title` | text | Required display value; retrieved, user-authored, or address-derived fallback |
| `title_sort_key` | text | Required Unicode-normalized, case-folded title used for deterministic title ordering |
| `title_provenance` | enum | `fallback`, `retrieved`, or `user` |
| `retrieved_title_candidate` | nullable text | Latest retrieved alternative when a user title must not be overwritten |
| `description` | text | May be empty; retrieved or user-authored |
| `description_provenance` | enum | `fallback`, `retrieved`, or `user` |
| `retrieved_description_candidate` | nullable text | Latest retrieved alternative when a user description must not be overwritten |
| `icon_hash` | nullable text | Foreign key to a validated app-origin PNG; null uses the placeholder |
| `metadata_status` | enum | `pending`, `complete`, `partial`, `failed`, or `skipped_unsafe` |
| `metadata_error_code` | nullable enum | Friendly category such as timeout, denied destination, unsupported content, too large, or unavailable |
| `metadata_fetched_at` | nullable timestamp | Completion time of the last applicable attempt |
| `note_markdown` | text | Canonical user-authored note; empty by default |
| `note_plain` | text | Derived visible text used by search |
| `is_favorite` | boolean | Independent of reading/archive state; false by default |
| `is_unread` | boolean | True means Read Later; false by default |
| `archived_at` | nullable timestamp | Null means active; non-null means archived |
| `created_at` | timestamp | Immutable creation time |
| `updated_at` | timestamp | Refreshed by user-visible content/state changes and applied metadata |

### Bookmark Invariants

- `normalized_address` has a unique index. Application pre-checks improve UX; the constraint resolves races.
- A bookmark is in Read Later only when `is_unread = 1 AND archived_at IS NULL`.
- Archiving changes only `archived_at`; it never clears favorite or unread state.
- Restoring clears `archived_at`, so a retained unread bookmark reappears in Read Later.
- A metadata result may update a row only when its captured `address_revision` still equals the current value.
- A metadata result may update title or description only when that field's provenance is not `user`.
- Changing an address first checks uniqueness. On conflict, the edited bookmark remains unchanged.
- `note_plain` and the search index update in the same transaction as `note_markdown`.
- `title_sort_key` updates in the same transaction as `title` and title sorting uses `id` as the final tie-breaker.

### Bookmark State Transitions

```text
Reading:  read <──────────────> unread / Read Later
Archive:  active ─────────────> archived
          archived ───────────> active

Metadata: pending ────────────> complete
          pending ────────────> partial
          pending ────────────> failed
          pending ────────────> skipped_unsafe
          any non-pending ────> pending (address change or explicit refresh)

Deletion: active or archived ─> permanently removed
```

Reading and favorite transitions are independent from archive transitions.

## Bookmark Icon

Stores a safe, deduplicated site icon served only from the app origin.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `content_hash` | text | Primary key generated from re-encoded bytes |
| `png_bytes` | blob | Validated, bounded, re-encoded PNG only |
| `width` | integer | Positive and within the configured icon bound |
| `height` | integer | Positive and within the configured icon bound |
| `byte_length` | integer | Positive and within the configured transfer/storage bound |
| `created_at` | timestamp | Cache creation time |

An icon row may be referenced by many bookmarks. Unreferenced icons may be removed by maintenance; losing an icon never loses a bookmark and falls back to the placeholder.

## Tag

Represents a reusable flat label.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | Primary key |
| `display_name` | text | Trimmed user-facing spelling |
| `name_key` | text | Unicode-normalized, whitespace-normalized, case-folded unique key |
| `created_at` | timestamp | Creation time |

`name_key` is unique. A repeated spelling variant resolves to the existing tag.

## Bookmark Tag

Many-to-many relationship between bookmarks and tags.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `bookmark_id` | integer | Foreign key to Bookmark, cascade on delete |
| `tag_id` | integer | Foreign key to Tag, cascade on delete |

The composite `(bookmark_id, tag_id)` is the primary key. An index on `(tag_id, bookmark_id)` supports exact tag expressions, multi-tag filters, and bulk tag actions. Tags left with no bookmark may be garbage-collected, but saved views preserve their own tag keys.

## Saved View

Stores live search/filter criteria, never bookmark result identifiers.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | Primary key |
| `display_name` | text | Trimmed non-empty user-facing name |
| `name_key` | text | Unicode-normalized, case-folded unique key |
| `query_text` | text | Original validated search expression |
| `grammar_version` | integer | Starts at 1; migration point for future syntax changes |
| `scope` | enum | `active`, `read_later`, or `archived` |
| `favorite_filter` | nullable boolean | Null means any |
| `unread_filter` | nullable boolean | Null means any; scope rules still apply |
| `sort_order` | enum | `created_desc`, `created_asc`, `updated_desc`, or `title_asc` |
| `created_at` | timestamp | Creation time |
| `updated_at` | timestamp | Last rename or criteria update |

`name_key` is unique. The search expression must parse successfully before create/update. Opening a saved view reparses and evaluates current data.

## Saved View Tag

Stores one required tag filter for a saved view.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `saved_view_id` | integer | Foreign key to Saved View, cascade on delete |
| `tag_key` | text | Preserved normalized tag criterion |
| `display_name` | text | Last saved display label |

The composite `(saved_view_id, tag_key)` is the primary key. `tag_key` deliberately does not reference the live Tag table: deleting the last use of a tag leaves the saved criterion intact and produces the specified editable empty result.

## Selection Set

An expiring, non-user-content snapshot used for safe bulk actions.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | text | Opaque random token primary key |
| `criteria_hash` | text | Hash of the view state that produced the selection |
| `selected_count` | integer | Count shown for confirmation |
| `created_at` | timestamp | Snapshot time |
| `expires_at` | timestamp | Short expiry; abandoned sets are deleted on startup and periodically |

Selection sets are not restored as user state after expiration and do not appear in backups as meaningful content.

## Selection Item

Materializes selection membership.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `selection_id` | text | Foreign key to Selection Set, cascade on delete |
| `bookmark_id` | integer | Foreign key to Bookmark, cascade on delete |

The composite `(selection_id, bookmark_id)` is the primary key. An index on `bookmark_id` supports cascades. A view change deletes the current set; a bulk action consumes and deletes it in the same transaction.

## Bookmark Search Index

A contentful FTS5 virtual table whose `rowid` equals `bookmarks.id`.

| Column | Content |
|---|---|
| `title` | Search-normalized title |
| `address` | Search-normalized destination address |
| `description` | Search-normalized description |
| `note_plain` | Search-normalized visible note text |

The table uses the trigram tokenizer over already case-normalized text. Tags stay relational. Bookmark and FTS rows are inserted, updated, and deleted in one transaction, and integrity is checked in migration/maintenance tests.

## Schema Migration

Tracks ordered, immutable SQL migrations.

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | integer | Primary key |
| `name` | text | Migration label |
| `applied_at` | timestamp | Successful application time |

Startup applies pending migrations transactionally before the server reports ready.

## Index Plan

- Unique: `bookmarks(normalized_address)`
- Listing: `(archived_at, created_at, id)`, `(archived_at, updated_at, id)`, `(archived_at, title_sort_key, id)`
- Status: `(archived_at, is_unread, created_at, id)`, `(archived_at, is_favorite, created_at, id)`
- Tags: unique `tags(name_key)`, `bookmark_tags(tag_id, bookmark_id)`, and its primary key
- Saved views: unique `saved_views(name_key)`, `saved_view_tags(tag_key, saved_view_id)`
- Selections: primary membership key and `selection_items(bookmark_id)`

The implementation must verify these with representative `EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN` output and the approved elapsed-time acceptance tests rather than relying on index presence alone.
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Personal Bookmark Manager API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Same-origin JSON contract for the approved single-user application.
  license:
    name: Proprietary
    identifier: LicenseRef-Proprietary
servers:
  - url: /api
security: []
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Check application readiness
      operationId: getHealth
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Server and migrated database are ready.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [status]
                properties:
                  status:
                    const: ready
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'

  /metadata/preview:
    post:
      summary: Preview metadata for an address
      operationId: previewMetadata
      description: Begins automatically after a valid address is entered. The client may save independently while this bounded request is pending.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [address]
              properties:
                address:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Retrieved metadata or a usable fallback result.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/MetadataPreview'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/DuplicateBookmark'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'

  /bookmarks:
    get:
      summary: List and search bookmarks
      operationId: listBookmarks
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Scope'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Query'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Tags'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Favorite'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Unread'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Sort'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Cursor'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Limit'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Current result page and total result count.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookmarkPage'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/SearchError'
    post:
      summary: Save a bookmark
      operationId: createBookmark
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookmarkCreate'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Bookmark saved; metadata may still be pending.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Bookmark'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/DuplicateBookmark'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'

  /bookmarks/{bookmarkId}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/BookmarkId'
    get:
      summary: Get a bookmark
      operationId: getBookmark
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Bookmark detail.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Bookmark'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
    patch:
      summary: Update a bookmark
      operationId: updateBookmark
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookmarkPatch'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated bookmark.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Bookmark'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/DuplicateBookmark'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'
    delete:
      summary: Permanently delete a bookmark
      operationId: deleteBookmark
      description: The client must obtain explicit user confirmation before sending this request.
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Permanently deleted.
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'

  /bookmarks/{bookmarkId}/metadata-refresh:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/BookmarkId'
    post:
      summary: Refresh bookmark metadata
      operationId: refreshBookmarkMetadata
      responses:
        '202':
          description: A revision-guarded metadata refresh was queued.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [bookmarkId, metadataStatus]
                properties:
                  bookmarkId:
                    type: integer
                  metadataStatus:
                    const: pending
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'

  /bookmarks/{bookmarkId}/icon:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/BookmarkId'
    get:
      summary: Get a safe bookmark icon
      operationId: getBookmarkIcon
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Validated app-origin PNG icon.
          headers:
            X-Content-Type-Options:
              schema:
                const: nosniff
          content:
            image/png:
              schema:
                type: string
                contentEncoding: binary
        '404':
          description: Use the client placeholder icon.

  /tags:
    get:
      summary: List tags
      operationId: listTags
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Existing tags and active bookmark counts.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/TagSummary'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'

  /selections:
    post:
      summary: Snapshot a bookmark selection
      operationId: createSelection
      description: Snapshots individual IDs or every bookmark matching the current criteria.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              oneOf:
                - type: object
                  additionalProperties: false
                  required: [mode, ids, criteriaHash]
                  properties:
                    mode:
                      const: ids
                    ids:
                      type: array
                      minItems: 1
                      uniqueItems: true
                      items:
                        type: integer
                    criteriaHash:
                      type: string
                - type: object
                  additionalProperties: false
                  required: [mode, criteria, criteriaHash]
                  properties:
                    mode:
                      const: all_results
                    criteria:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/SearchCriteria'
                    criteriaHash:
                      type: string
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Stable expiring selection snapshot.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Selection'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/SearchError'

  /selections/{selectionId}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/SelectionId'
    delete:
      summary: Clear a bookmark selection
      operationId: clearSelection
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Selection cleared or already absent.
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'

  /selections/{selectionId}/actions:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/SelectionId'
    post:
      summary: Apply a bulk action
      operationId: applyBulkAction
      description: Consumes the stable selection in one transaction. The client confirms permanent deletion before requesting it.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/BulkAction'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Selection consumed and action committed.
import { type Static, type TSchema, Type } from "typebox";

function inline<T extends TSchema>(schema: T): T {
  const copy = { ...schema } as T & { $id?: string };
  delete copy.$id;
  return copy;
}

  retrievedDescriptionCandidate: string | null;

  archived: boolean;

  updatedAt: string;

  address: string;
  normalized_address: string;
  address_revision: number;
  title: string;
  title_sort_key: string;
  title_provenance: Provenance;
  retrieved_title_candidate: string | null;

function fixtureAddress(id: number): string {
  return `https://example.test/articles/${id}`;
}

export function makeTag(overrides: Partial<TagFixture> = {}): TagFixture {
  const id = overrides.id ?? 1;
  return { id, name: overrides.name ?? `Tag ${id}` };
}

export function makeBookmark(overrides: Partial<BookmarkFixture> = {}): BookmarkFixture {
  const id = overrides.id ?? 1;
  return {
    id,
    address: fixtureAddress(id),
    title: `Example bookmark ${id}`,
    titleProvenance: "retrieved",
    retrievedTitleCandidate: null,
    description: `A deterministic description for bookmark ${id}.`,
    descriptionProvenance: "retrieved",
    retrievedDescriptionCandidate: null,
    iconUrl: `/api/bookmarks/${id}/icon`,
    metadataStatus: "complete",
    metadataErrorCode: null,
    noteMarkdown: "",
    favorite: false,
